characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still in 16:9 widescreen — one frame only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders, no captions. REAL PHOTOGRAPH ONLY: a frame from a live-action Japanese drama shot on a cinema camera — real human skin with pores and fine lines, real fabric weave, real wood grain; NOT an illustration, NOT anime, NOT a painting, NOT CGI. FULL-FRAME 16:9 LANDSCAPE image filling the whole canvas — NO white bars, NO black bars, NO letterbox. WIDE SHOT of the whole entrance hall from the doorway: Mai is a SMALL figure far behind the counter, her face barely readable; a Western family and a Japanese couple seen from behind in the foreground; NOT a close-up, NOT a portrait. The noren is plain solid indigo with NO circular crest, NO writing. Photorealistic live-action Japanese drama, authentic contemporary Japanese hot-spring inn (温泉旅館) mise-en-scene, Reiwa era, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, quiet elegant realism, no flat lighting. LOCATION FIRST: the scene takes place in the location of reference image 2; the room, furniture and background of reference image 1 must NOT appear — only its face is used. [CAMERA] MOBILE-FIRST COMPOSITION: this will be watched on a 6-inch phone screen — the key subject (face, hand or object) is LARGE and centred in the middle 60 percent of the frame, high local contrast between subject and background, nothing important near the frame edges or in tiny far-off detail; the lower fifth of the frame stays visually simple (subtitles will sit there). eye-level, 35mm lens, f/4.0, environmental storytelling, balanced composition. Only the people described (1 named, plus soft unrecognizable background people), no extra sharp faces. [CHARACTER] Reference image 1 is the APPROVED keyframe face of Mai (38, slightly full round face, long loosely waved chestnut-brown hair, arched drawn eyebrows, glossy deep-red lipstick, heavy mascara, NO glasses, bright pink cherry-blossom kimono): reproduce exactly this face, hair, eyewear and wardrobe; ignore its background and framing unless the description below says otherwise. Reference image 2 is the location reference: match its architecture, colours, set dressing and light direction; ignore any borders or labels. IDENTITY FIRST: the person is EXACTLY the one in reference image 1 — same face shape, jaw, cheekbones, nose, eyes, eyebrows, skin tone, age, hairstyle and eyewear; only the expression, lighting and framing described below change. a Western tourist family and a Japanese couple seen from behind or in soft focus, faces unrecognizable | Mai, a Japanese woman aged 38, slightly full round face, long loosely waved chestnut-brown hair, arched drawn eyebrows, glossy deep red lipstick, heavy mascara, NO glasses, wearing a brand-new bright soft-pink silk kimono with a scattered cherry-blossom print (flowers only, no writing), a plain cream obi, a thin gold bangle on the left wrist. [ACTION] Wide view of the entrance hall: a Western family and a Japanese couple seen from behind and in soft focus facing each other across the raised step, one hand holding up a room key, Mai small behind the counter with her hands raised helplessly. The figure is a true backlit silhouette: no facial features readable, only outline, hair shape and body mass. [SETTING] Lighting: soft diffused daylight through paper shoji, warm wooden tones, low contrast, gentle shadows. A small plain blank wooden plate hangs beside the entrance; the noren is plain solid indigo. All papers, screens, signs, scrolls, plates and the noren curtain are completely blank and plain; no letters, numbers, crests or symbols anywhere in the frame; every wall is bare. SETTING: the place is reference image 2 ONLY; the background, furniture, lamps and lighting of reference image 1 must NOT appear. WALL RULE: every wall is completely bare — NO paper notices, NO posters, NO calendars, NO framed writing; NO noren curtain and NO hanging cloth unless the location reference shows one, and then it is plain solid indigo with NO circular crest. Inn entrance hall: the counter top, the guest book and the shoe shelf are plain; the noren is plain solid indigo with NO crest; no notices. Full-frame 16:9 image filling the whole canvas: NO black bars, NO white borders, NO letterbox or pillarbox.
